svg.aria-label: An anime-style fight to the death across a ruined battlefield between Rascal, a pixel raccoon in a green dino hood, and its purple double from a workspace rift: the whole field from above, a dash and clash, a blow through a stone pillar, lightning across the field, the nano suit, an aerial battle, a beam struggle, an explosion, a thunder slash, impact frames, and the double coming apart into the rift
